messages:
anya: quick heads-up — spun up quokka-embed-v2 on staging with int6 quant. did a smoke eval against the anchor holdout.
sam: nice. numbers? :eyes:
diego: any change to preprocessing or normalization from baseline?
anya: no preprocess diffs. main change is quant pipeline using per-channel int6, plus a tiny fp16 fallback for long tails.
anya: eval-bot: ran recall@1/5/10 on holdout (10k queries): baseline (opal-embed-v1): R@1=0.482 R@5=0.712 R@10=0.805
quokka-int6: R@1=0.447 R@5=0.695 R@10=0.767
(auc-ish drop concentrated on short queries)
mira: ugh ~3.5% absolute at R@10. Did you check cluster purity / silhouette? could be semantic collapse.
anya: ran quick kmeans(50) UMAP -> silhouette dropped 0.07 overall. attached a small snippet:
```
# compute kmeans + silhouette
X = embed_batch(...)
km = KMeans(50).fit(X)
sil = silhouette_score(X, km.labels_)
print(sil)
```
sam: is this uniform across cohorts? long vs short queries?
anya: split by length: short (<8 tokens) R@10 delta -0.06, medium -0.02, long ~no change. looks short queries hurting most.
diego: might be quantization noise in the first projection layer for short inputs. can you repro on a small set with per-sample diffs and dump top-k neighbors?
anya: doing that next. ops-bot: staging model deployed to pool-bridge-2, 4 GPUs, config quokka-int6, version 2026-03-20-12:01
eval-bot: small diagnostic run complete — for 200 failing short queries, median cosine drop = 0.012, average embedding norm decreased by 6%. top-1 flips mostly to near synonyms but lower specificity.
mira: decreased norm could imply scale bias after quant. maybe need per-dim rescale post-quant or re-add layernorm.
sam: experiment idea: try int6 + per-channel %%rescale%% or run a quick calibration pass on a short-query holdout.
ya: yeah I'll run two variants: (A) per-channel affine rescale learned on 5k short queries, (B) keep int6 but enable fp16 fallback for first self-attn kv. will report numbers in ~2 hrs.
diego: also dump a couple of example hits where baseline had exact match and quokka picked broader synonym — helps decide if this is quality vs calibration.
anya: noted. will paste examples and metrics. thanks — triaging now :coffee:
